name: Rosemary Garlic Oil
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ½ gallon any flavorless high-smoke point oil, such as canola, grapeseed, peanut, or safflower

steps: Heat the oil in your tallest largest pot over low heat. Add remaining ingredients and warm for 1 hour.
Strain and keep in an airtight container. Some may want to keep this in the refrigerator, others may not.
